# Slash command catalog

Reference for Long Horizon's built-in slash commands — the user-facing affordances (swap models, force a memory rollup, grant a HITL bypass, refresh skills, …) that `make_slash_command_dispatcher` intercepts before the model runs. Names come from `horizon/commands/__init__.py`; regenerate after changing the registry.

_Auto-generated from `horizon/commands/__init__.py`. Regenerate with `make commands-catalog`._

## Commands (9)

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `/dream-review` | Force an immediate dream-review pass, consolidating your Structured Profile from recent sessions. |
| `/grant` | Grant a per-session HITL bypass for a shell command — covers bash, process spawn, and process write shapes (no args lists active grants). |
| `/model` | Show or switch the root agent model for this session (no args lists available models). |
| `/permissions` | List session and persisted permission grants; `clear` drops the session grants. |
| `/reload` | Reload the skill catalog and invalidate cached secrets for this session. |
| `/routines` | List your scheduled routines; `remove <id>` cancels one. |
| `/sandbox-upgrade` | Upgrade your sandbox to the current runtime image and migrate the workspace. |
| `/workspace` | Show, set, or clear the per-session workspace focus directory. |
| `/yolo` | Toggle YOLO approval mode (auto-approve risky commands; exfil and catastrophic blocks remain). |
